texts: Train bank staff and officers on minority welfare programs during induction, rural lending, priority sector financing, and poverty alleviation courses for better understanding and implementation.

Banks should provide training sessions for staff on minority welfare programs, integrating lectures into courses on rural lending, priority sector financing, and poverty alleviation initiatives to ensure a proper understanding of these programs.
To ensure bank staff are aware of minority welfare programs, incorporate training sessions on these topics into induction, rural lending, priority sector financing, and poverty alleviation courses.

Train bank staff on minority welfare programs via lectures in all relevant training, including induction, rural lending, priority sector financing, and poverty alleviation courses to ensure proper understanding and perspective.
